W.note: Dense two-column layout with a visible cart, shipping progress and clear Add buttons, but gradient initial tiles look generic and the mobile layout clips the sort select and cards at the right edge.

X.note: Restrained neutral styling with line icons and sensible variant and sold-out states, but the cards are oversized with dead space, the cart sits below the grid, and the mobile header overflows and the column is offset.

Y.note: Clean gray line-art cards, but the Save links add unrequested clutter, the default variant for the pour-over set is sold out so the first view shows a disabled button, the tote is labelled Size for One size, and the mobile header overflows.

Z.note: The most complete shop job (stock counts, quantity steppers in the cart, free-shipping bar, real states) with a modern pill-and-shadow language, but blurbs and tags make it busier than asked and the narrow cards wrap names awkwardly and clip on mobile.
